51570703.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to full length human LXRalpha assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Assay - Experimental Section: SPR Assay. The SPR measurement was performed on the Biacore T100 system (GE Healthcare). Full-length human LXRα was immobilized on a CM5 chip (GE Healthcare). The K_D values were calculated using the dynamic fitting equation.
original_paragraph.Figure 2E Caption: Figure 2. Screening for LXRα agonists in vitro. (A) Relative mRNA levels of LXRα, CYP7A1, and ABCA1 in HepG2 cells co-cultured with nine marine NPs for 24 h. (B) HepG2 cell viability following treatment with 1 or 3 (1–50 μM) in HepG2 cells for 24 h, measured using the CCK8 assay. (C and D) WB for LXRα, ABCA1, and CYP7A1 protein levels in HepG2 cells treated with 1 or 3 (25 μM) for 24 h. (E) Affinity activity of 1 or 3 to the LXRα protein, analyzed using the SPR assay. Data shown are mean ± SEM (n = 3, **p < 0.01, ***p < 0.001).

analyte.concentration_range: 5 μM - 100 μM for compound 3; 12.5 μM - 100 μM for compound 1
